dogecoin.text:
🚀 Grayscale Launches Dogecoin Trust 

Grayscale has officially launched the Grayscale Dogecoin Trust, offering institutional and accredited investors exposure to Dogecoin. 

📌 Key Points:

Surge in Institutional Interest: The launch follows heightened demand for Dogecoin
BREAKING: Bitwise files for spot Dogecoin $DOGE ETF with NYSE
